scope: Local optional POC web workspace, D-053 / FR-028 / AC-011 / T21

warning_categories: Two PyIceberg delete operations did not match records
tests.browser: Existing Microsoft Edge, headless, isolated fresh contexts

verified_workflows: Public bundled assets, UI security headers, authenticated crawl admission
Authenticated exact-job body remains consistent after a newer generation succeeds
Missing, queued and failed job content returns not found
Keyboard skip-link focus and Enter submission
Actual API admission, controlled worker extraction, poll, metadata, topics and body
JSON download excludes the API key
